text:
maria: Quick sync — I'm drafting the PRD for tenant isolation & handshake options for VPC/on-prem private deploys. Need fast calls on: 1) IP allowlist vs mTLS (customer-managed networking), 2) upgrade path (in-place vs blue-green), 3) SLA/packaging scope. We need a tech direction to freeze packaging for next sprint. @dinesh @olivia please weigh in.

dinesh: Security-first: mTLS by default, IP allowlist opt-in. mTLS gives auth + integrity. downside: installer needs cert rotation support.

olivia: Field feedback: many customers prefer IP-based handshakes because netops can't run an internal CA. We should support both, but make opt-in UX crystal clear.

sam: From ops: mTLS complicates upgrades. Blue-green safer to avoid cert mismatch windows. If we do in-place, we need rolling cert swap + double-serve window.

katie: Product constraint: we can't ship rotation automation this cycle. Proposal: ship mTLS supported but with manual rotation for 1.0, and provide IP allowlist as the simpler recommended path. rotation becomes v1.1.

maria: Noted. Packaging config idea — use a single knob. Example mock config: ```
handshake:
  mode: mtls # mtls | ip | hybrid
  ip_ranges: ["10.0.0.0/16"]
  cert_issuer: customer-kms
```

alex: Config looks good. For `hybrid` we must define precedence (prefer mTLS if certs present). Also add `grace_period_seconds` for blue-green cutover behavior.

olivia: Field asks about NAT traversal — many on-prem setups sit behind NAT which complicates direct peering. Suggest we document limitations and offer a relay/peering option via customer VPC as a fallback.

dinesh: Security note on relay: must have strict audit logging and limited scope. Ensure logs don't leak sensitive material. Add an `audit_enabled` flag in the config.

sam: Spinning tickets: ENG-4021 (blue-green orchestration), ENG-4022 (handshake config parser + validation), ENG-4023 (installer UI for network choices). I'll attach rough estimates in the ticket.

katie: Can we list launch criteria? Minimal proposal: 1) `handshake.mode` validated end-to-end for mtls and ip on testnet, 2) blue-green cutover tested with KV cache warmup and rollback, 3) packaging docs + ops-runbook. Add anything missing.

alex: Add regression: fallback routing to hosted model variant when private capacity unavailable (routing/policy test).

maria: Good list. I'll update the PRD and freeze packaging flags for this sprint. Mark rotation automation as v1.1. Next: eng owners assigned + follow-up sync Thu 10:00 PT. @ops-bot please create the epics and meeting.

ops-bot: Created epics ENG-4021, ENG-4022, ENG-4023 and scheduled follow-up Thu 10:00 PT. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ENG-4021 :calendar: 

olivia: :thumbsup: I'll gather field customer examples and drop them here by Wednesday.
